# Davis Roofing & Exteriors

> Locally owned roofing, siding, window and gutter contractor based in Staunton, Virginia, founded by Jordan Davis. Crews serve the Shenandoah Valley and the Richmond–Midlothian metro.

- Phone: (540) 534-5380
- Email: info@davisroofingandexteriors.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern
- Free estimates; financing available

## Services
- [Roof replacement and repair](https://davisroofingandexteriors.com/service-roofing.html): full tear-off replacements, storm damage repair, asphalt shingle and standing seam metal
- [Siding](https://davisroofingandexteriors.com/service-siding.html): vinyl, fiber cement and engineered wood
- [Windows and doors](https://davisroofingandexteriors.com/service-windows-and-doors.html): energy-efficient replacement windows and doors
- [Seamless gutters](https://davisroofingandexteriors.com/service-gutters.html): aluminum gutters formed on site, downspouts and gutter guards

## Service areas
- Shenandoah Valley: Staunton, Waynesboro, Fishersville, Stuarts Draft, Verona, Greenville, Mount Sidney, Churchville and Augusta County
- Richmond metro: Richmond, Midlothian, Chesterfield, Glen Allen, Henrico, Mechanicsville, Short Pump and Powhatan
- Also Charlottesville and Palmyra
- Details: https://davisroofingandexteriors.com/service-areas.html
